Metadata.title: YiLink
Metadata.description: An open-source link-in-bio for Chinese creators

Marketing.tagline: One link for everything you make.
Marketing.description: YiLink is an open-source link-in-bio tool for Chinese creators.

Login.title: Log in to YiLink
Login.invalidFields: Enter a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.
Login.registered: Registration complete. You can now log in.

Register.title: Create an account
Register.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters; letters, numbers, and symbols are recommended.
Register.shortPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.

Studio.title: My page
Studio.description: Start with a scene template, then shape every detail into your own page.
Studio.emptyDescription: Choose a template for your use case, then customize the content, theme, and publishing settings.
Studio.chooseTemplateHint: Templates provide a theme, layout, and useful starter copy. Everything stays editable.
Studio.slugHint: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens; start and end with a letter or number.
Studio.ctaDescription: Set one primary action at the bottom of the page for contact or a destination link.
Studio.ctaUniqueHint: One-conversion rule: when the WeChat CTA is on, WeChat blocks are hidden in preview and on the public page.
Studio.pageSettingsHint: Identity details update in the preview instantly.

blocks.title: Content blocks
blocks.empty: No content blocks yet. Add one from the menu above.
blocks.dividerHint: Dividers have no additional settings and use the current theme's hairline style.

defaults.text: Write a short, concrete introduction about yourself.
